name: notepad
what_is_it: the Windows Notepad text editor with rich-text formatting and multi-tab support
used_for: creating, editing, and organizing plain-text and lightly formatted notes across multiple tabs
who_uses: everyday Windows users, students, and professionals jotting notes, lists, and drafts

feature_inventory.name: Window Controls
feature_inventory.one_liner: minimize, maximize, close, and system menu for the app window

feature_inventory.name: Text Editing
feature_inventory.one_liner: main document area for typing and editing note content

feature_inventory.name: Tab Management
feature_inventory.one_liner: switch between and add multiple open note tabs

feature_inventory.name: Menu Bar
feature_inventory.one_liner: File, Edit, and View menus for document and app commands

feature_inventory.name: Text Formatting
feature_inventory.one_liner: headings, lists, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, tables, and clear-formatting controls

feature_inventory.name: AI Writing Tools
feature_inventory.one_liner: AI-assisted writing tools (requires local model download when signed out)

feature_inventory.name: Account & Settings
feature_inventory.one_liner: user avatar, what's-new, and app settings access

feature_inventory.name: Status Bar
feature_inventory.one_liner: shows cursor position, character count, text mode, zoom, line ending, and encoding
